conf.description: Building Automation (Niagara) alarm-events api-pull direct route: oBIX Alarming feed / BQL alarm-database collector JSON row parse, severity inversion, ECS rename, no vendor pack/integration exists

conf.comment: Niagara AlarmService rows pulled via oBIX watch/feed poll (minimal Alarming contract) or scheduled BQL alarm-database query (adds uuid/alarmClass/priority/sourceState/ackState). Assumes the Collector delivers one JSON/NDJSON row per _raw; oBIX obj XML is NOT handled here (see README gap). No vendor pack/integration exists.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, transport assumption and known gap
Extract the oBIX/BQL alarm row into top-level fields

Custom bas.niagara.alarm.* namespace copies plus the priority-to-severity inversion (BQL path only; oBIX minimal contract has no priority) and alarmValue flattening; event.outcome intentionally NOT set - no success/failure notion on this record, left to the Elastic ingest pipeline
Batch rename of the directly-mapped columns; uuid (BQL path) is the cross-record correlation key, absent on the minimal oBIX Alarming contract
Event time from the oBIX Alarming-contract abstime (platform constraint: never target @timestamp)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop staging fields consumed into their ECS/custom targets above
